newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to issue T$5 bln NCDs on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue T$5 bln NCDs on Wednesday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Wednesday it would issue T$5 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposit later in the day.
Bids would close at 15.00 local time (0700 GMT), a central bank official said.
The central bank has said its recent series of NCD issues aimed to absorb banking system's extra money, but not to dampen stock market turnover as many analysts have asserted.
